schemaNote: Operator lane overrides for COF001. Each item moves one SKU line of an invoice or credit note from its SKU-rule lane to the other lane, for every statement whose config sets laneOverridesFile to this file. Lines dated inside the window are routed directly; lines dated before it adjust the opening 1A/1B balances and the Part 2 custody opening. The combined balance never changes. The ERP documents are not changed; when the ERP corrects them, remove the item and regenerate.
